results.title: Laos-Malaysia Trade Rises 158 Percent to USD 60.7 Million in 2025
results.content: Trade between Laos and Malaysia rose 157.8 percent to USD 60.7 million in 2025, according to figures from Malaysia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, as the two countries seek to strengthen economic ties. results.title: Laos, North Korea Hold First Joint Committee Meeting in 12 Years
results.content: On 19 November, Laos and North Korea held the 4th Joint Committee Meeting on Economic, Trade, Scientific and Technological Cooperation in Pyongyang and signed a protocol at the end of the session, Lao state media reported.
